places.name: Republican River
places.note: Unimpressive from afar; Augustus recalls it took the Pumphrey boy; the herd swims it without loss and Jasper dances a jig in relief.

places.name: Stinking Water Creek
places.note: Crossed by the herd as the hands fret over whether they'll be paid in Ogallala.
places.location_hint: north of the Republican River on the way to Ogallala, southwest Nebraska

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: The hands hope for a town visit once they reach it; Augustus promises half wages there.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Call asks if Augustus will leave Lorena there; the hands dream of whores and get promised half pay there.

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Call broods that Jake was allowed to stray from the herd there.

places.name: Red River
places.note: Soupy says he got soaked enough down there to last forever.

places.name: Montana
places.note: The hands signed on for Montana; Call fears Indians before reaching it.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit with the herd
groups.hint: north of the Republican, past the Stinking Water, heading for Ogallala on the Platte
